title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch

meta.Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
S-So, Shiraishi and Tono...
Do you think they're still in talks with Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It has been taking them quite a long time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, that owner isn't gonna budge so easily. We just have to hope that their negotiations are going well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone seems anxious about this. Even I'm uneasy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Today is the day we're supposed to find out whether or not we get to do our event there. Also...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Taiga said he'd come and watch.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Taiga's really coming to see our event?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That is, if we manage to book Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all want to see Taiga there.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And so do I... I really want to see how he reacts after seeing our event...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want him to see where I'm at now in terms of singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, Tono! Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, we're back!
Man, that was nerve-wracking! I really hate doing these sorts of negotiations!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Shiraishi. You as well, Tono.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: S-So, how'd it go?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We were given the green light.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We appreciate it, you guys.
Thanks for going over to talk to them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you both so much, An, Tono!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, you're giving us too much credit. I believe our second event actually did most of the talking for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally! The owner sat there really quietly as he watched the video of it... And then, at the end, he asked, “When do you want to perform?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That's great since we all felt very good about it afterwards.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! So, this win was a team effort!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
We made sure to remind the owner about that other thing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Remember what Arata said...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I told him, “We're going to put on an event that's even better and more packed than the one RADder put on when they debuted!”

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember. So, you were serious about that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Of course I was. I mean, surpassing RAD WEEKEND will remain a pipe dream if we don't believe we can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the owner quickly responded to that by saying, “Don't get ahead of yourselves!”

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
I can imagine...
He's always been a tough judge to please.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Also, Akito... He surprised us by asking that we relay a message to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To me...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: “I remember you and what you look like. If you mess up again, that's it for you.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He remembers...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But that doesn't matter...
Because we get to do our next event at Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Which means Taiga's going to come see us perform!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, you all sound pretty excited today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, Ken!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I take it you just received some good news? Why don't you all have a round of drinks on me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks, Dad!
I'll get everyone's orders now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for always being so generous.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Don't mention it. You guys are regulars here after all.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: By the way, I just overheard some of the conversation you were just having. Is it true...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you talking about us playing at Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
There's that, but...
Is Taiga actually going to see your next event?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, Ken. What's...? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga! Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You gotta hear this! We just got the green light to do our next event at Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh? You actually managed to get that old geezer to listen? Not bad.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which means I need to fulfill my promise...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness...! That means you're coming to see us...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, relax.
I'm just one extra spectator.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, having to go all by myself doesn't seem right... So, Ken...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Wanna come with?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Alright...
I should every so often.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Dad, you're gonna come see us perform...?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, since it's pretty rare of Taiga to invite me like this. I feel that not accepting would be a bad idea.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hah hah hah. You can thank the great Taiga for your thriving business!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, add two more to the guest list. Once you guys have hammered out all the details... Tell Ken.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing your event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Whoa, no way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Taiga coming to watch is already scarcely believable, but Ken's joining him...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. I'm starting to get really nervous...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, An, mind taking everyone's orders...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? R-Right! Gimme one sec...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, Taiga, what'll you have?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I need to take this...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Never a dull moment...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, here's the pizza!
Mind moving your cups and stuff for me?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
I'm taking a slice while it's still nice and hot!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(Taiga still hasn't come back...
I guess that call's taking longer than expected.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(But it's going to be dark soon...
I should turn the light on for the sign.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Hm...? That sounded like...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, start in Los Angeles and work our way across the country to New York? Not bad.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright, got it...
I'll be heading back soon, so we can discuss contracts and all that then.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, Ken. Were you there the whole time?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're going back to the States?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What's that? Were you eavesdropping on my call?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: A musician friend called to ask if I'd be interested in doing a US tour. I sort of can't refuse...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, there you two are...
I need to head home soon, so I thought I should say bye before I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
What you made for us was really good.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Come back whenever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I will! Oh, also, Taiga...
I'm looking forward to practicing again next week!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You're so old-fashioned.
Anyway, see you then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, I'm gonna see Kohane out!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure thing. It's getting dark, so be careful, okay?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I've seen this look on Taiga's face before.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Taiga wants Kohane and her to...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you going to leave your student behind...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What? Are you talking about us practicing...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It was just an old man's whim.
Unfortunately for her, that's all the time I've got.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you promised her that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I promised her what...?
More importantly, I'm parched. A beer sounds great right about now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Pace yourself.
I'm pretty sure it's going to rain tonight.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I should have remembered the forecast said it would rain tonight... Thanks for letting me borrow one of your umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, don't worry about it! We keep these around just in case this sort of thing happens!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, today was packed full of surprises...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only is Uncle Taiga gonna come see our event, so is my dad now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I couldn't believe it... And I'm really happy. I want to make it a good event if they're both going to be there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, as prickly as you, your dad and the others said he is, I want the owner to acknowledge us as being good...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to make the most of my practice with Taiga next week...!)
One week later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, this is a great angle!
I'll try taking your photo like this.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Of course. Just promise to capture my good side, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I promise!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I think I got in some really good shots...)

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Hm? Kohane? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's you! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was working on my singing by going around and taking photos of the city.

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: You're working on your singing? By taking photos? Oh, this must be another one of Taiga's weird training methods...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-They're not weird...
Just a little different.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line:
So, how did it turn out?
Did you get my good side?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, here! Please take a look.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line:
Wow...! You're good!
Would you mind giving me a copy? I'd like to send one to my grandchildren...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll bring some by your store later.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: But I feel like you have it kinda rough sometimes. I've seen you walking around speaking only foreign languages and copying animal noises before. You know you're allowed to complain to him, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha...
Actually, I think there's a purpose behind all those things.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel like they've given me the chance to think about how I express myself and use my imagination when singing...

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Really? So, he's not just messing with you? Maybe I should be helping you too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
I thought you were about to go somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: No, my boyfriend just said that he's gonna be running late, so I have some time on my hands now. Ask me anything! Want me to strike some poses for you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much! Then...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, how's it going?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Taiga!
Can you take a look at this photo? I thought it turned out really well.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, you captured her smile really well. Especially considering how she has an infamous scowl.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For each photo, I asked the people in them to help me, and they all agreed after I mentioned that I was practicing with you, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was watching you from afar, but you seem to have been making a lot of friends around here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I am. And it's because you've been nice enough to take me to all these different places.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was actually a little scared of Vivid Street not too long ago...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I feel really comfortable here after singing with An and the others, and walking around with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone here's so warm, friendly and really welcoming... It's really nice.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, you like it here...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes...
I like things here very much!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Then, as long as you do, this place should reciprocate that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And when it does...

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: I thought I heard a familiar voice just now. Hello there, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You came out to see me...?
Glad to see that you're still doing well.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line:
Hmph. Don't write me off just yet.
I'm not croaking until I see you...er...WALKER stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (WALKER...? Oh, that's his stage name...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. You listen to me too?

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Don't forget that I've been watching you since you were just a kid. It's only natural for me to want to see you become a fully-fledged artist.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: So, Taiga, good luck over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(She really cares about him.
She's even known him since he was really young...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to imagine what Taiga was like when he was little...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can tell that he really grew up here...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Now then. Sorry for getting sidetracked, but we'll have to call our practice here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to go practice for our event now, so if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Wait before you go...
We're finished practicing for today, but there's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um... Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was just recently asked to do a US tour... And I plan to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! A US tour?! That's incredible...! Congratulations, Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Things just got really big all of a sudden... He really must be an amazing singer... And he's teaching me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wait, but...
If he accepts this offer to go on tour and goes over to the US...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I don't have much time left to practice with you and teach you things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
B-But...!
Again, congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Thanks. So, as a little assessment, why don't you sing for me right now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What...?
You want to hear me sing...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. Anything you like. And it doesn't have to be long since your voice probably isn't warmed up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that told me more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You've improved a lot since the last time I heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Really?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I can see why that geezer at Crawl Green likes you so much. He's definitely got a good eye.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Singing's a complicated thing.
Just being good isn't enough to get through to others.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why I wasn't teaching you to become a better singer technically. You need to possess certain more intrinsic qualities to accomplish that. Qualities that we have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Intrinsic qualities...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You've done well up to this point.
And you seem to have sort of realized why I had you do all those things.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I still don't have the full picture...
However, this has given me a chance to rethink how I should practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example, I've become better at imagining what a song is supposed to be about and how to express what's in my mind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And by struggling to speak in a foreign language, I've figured out how to stop relying on lyrics and put emotion into my voice itself.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
Everything you just mentioned is essential to singing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Skills aren't actually what's “most important” when it comes to singing well or producing good music.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: If you keep improving your understanding of how to get a clear image in your head and actually express that by singing, the sky's going to be the limit for you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That along with everything else will help you figure out what's “most important”. There's more to singing than just singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That reminds me of what you told me the other day...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, my point is that just singing isn't enough. I want you to at least take that away from this...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, you have a good memory.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember because I really had no idea back then what walking around the city had to do with singing...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Really? But it seems like you're friends with everyone around here now...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which means your next event should be a good chance...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going to give you one last assignment. Let's call it...your final.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My final...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
What would you like me to do?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Perform by yourself during your next event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-By myself...?! Alone...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right... But I'm not telling you to leave your team or stop singing with An and the others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay... Thank goodness...
But... How am I supposed to do that...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Well, for example...
Remember what Nagi did for RAD WEEKEND? You could be the opening act.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The opening act...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. How you go about that is up to you, but I think you'll be able to face the audience better by performing alone since you'll have them all to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Also, even though I know you have some experience flying solo, performing by yourself for your own event is something else.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You'll find out what I mean when you take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But this isn't the time or place to decide whether you do it. If you are interested, you should ask your teammates about this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me...? Performing solo during our event...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it really okay for me to...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Singing first means...
I'm the one setting the pace for our event. Like Nagi did for RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But An and Tono had to work really hard to book the venue for our event. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, if we do get to sing at Crawl Green, I promise to put on a performance that's going to floor everyone there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's going to be an important event for Shinonome...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Knowing all that, if I mess up...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was just recently asked to do a US tour... And I plan to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I don't have much time left to practice with you and teach you things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This may be my only chance to have Taiga see me sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If this really is it, then I might... No, I'll definitely regret it if I let this chance slip.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to give it a try...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's already time for practice...!
The others said that I didn't have to come if I became too pressed for time, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hmm... You produce such a clean sound, Toya. It's actually a bit of a shame that you're trying to keep everything short and sweet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Then, I'll try sounding a little rougher by using more power than usual.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which means...
Sorry, Akito, but I'll need you to give me some extra time for that part.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem.
We can find a balance as we go along.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all sound so serious. Plus...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The air feels so tense.
They're all really focused...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... I guess that makes sense...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We get to perform where those three... Where RADder made their big debut.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(They were still in high school too...
Which means they were our age.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In that sense, we're sort of alike...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(That means I need to do my best.
Also, what Taiga said earlier...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane...!
Welcome back! You done practicing with Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, An, everyone.
Sorry for running late.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We knew that there was a chance you wouldn't be able to make it today, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, what did you do with Taiga today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We went around taking photos of people in this city. But I didn't really understand what that had to do with singing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. His methods really do seem strange at times.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hey, Azusawa, you made it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all here, let's call practice here and start discussing our next event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it'll be better to have this discussion sooner rather than later since it's going to affect how we practice moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Right.
The people who go to the venue are a tough crowd, so I don't want to take any chances.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Plus, it's pretty rare of the owner to allow someone else to rent out the place and put on an event there. I have to think that expectations are going to be very high.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, this is a huge chance for us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is really exciting.
So, what kind of event do you guys want this to be?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well...
We chose a theme during our last discussion, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...!
There's something I need to ask you guys. Mind if I butt in...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, um...
A-About our next event...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to open for us. By myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean? By yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. So, Taiga told me just now that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Uncle Taiga put you up to this...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Makes sense...
Also, Azusawa, you already have some experience performing solo, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I do. Right after we formed our team, I performed a little here and there to gain more experience...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But the events you were in back then weren't all that big... This time, I mean... We're talking about Crawl Green here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... I know that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Were we wrong about her this whole time...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is she better than we could've ever realized...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm for it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Based on where Kohane is right now, she should be able to handle flying solo. However, she's gonna need to practice for it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I think it's worth a shot since you might strike it rich again like you did during STAY GOLDEN. After all, you getting better means we get better as a team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
At the very least...
I'm willing to bet on your performance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I'm on the fence.
In terms of going solo, I feel that I would be the better choice.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If Kohane believes she has what it takes to reach even greater heights... Then, I'd like to give her a chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Greater heights, huh...?
Yeah, I wanna give Kohane a chance too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, if it's okay with you guys, I'd like to let Kohane do this. I mean, we still have plenty of time before the event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Let's move forward with that in mind. At minimum, Azusawa definitely has what it takes to succeed here.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I don't mind either and I agree with Shinonome. I have a feeling that Azusawa is going to transform again like she did during the last STAY GOLDEN.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I promise to do my best! I won't let you down...!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(My intonation's still off.
I need to sing more with more precision...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's going to be my job to get the crowd going from scratch. I need to really burst out of the gates sprinting...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And this may be Taiga's last chance to see me perform. At Crawl Green of all places too... I can't let this opportunity go to waste...!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
She seems so focused.
You said she's been like this every day lately?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... Outside of team practices, she's apparently been singing on Vivid Street, at Nonogi Park and other places.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just the day before, she lost track of time and stayed out super late, and her dad got really mad at her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The day before yesterday? So, after we practiced?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I didn't realize that had stayed back so late...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I've been practicing with you guys for a while now, but I still can't believe sometimes how much stamina you all have.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, the way she sang just now concerns me a little...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, Azusawa, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, of course. How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way you sang just now... I thought I should mention that I feel like you're straining to sing louder.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... You guys thought so too?
I dunno how to describe it, but it's like you're having trouble finding your highest gear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You think so? I thought she was singing fine...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, this might be because we're so used to hearing her sing and know what she sounds like when she's at her best...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was doing my best to not let it affect my singing, but I guess I can't hide it anymore...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I'm starting to feel the pressure of having to set the pace for the entire event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, we don't blame you.
But it's not like you're singing bad or anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. You've accrued plenty of experience up to this point, Azusawa. I believe you'll do just fine if you practice like we normally do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Tono, Mita!
Would you mind practicing with me for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You've both been performing by yourselves for a long time, so I'd like it if you could tell me anything that bothers you!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Haha. As tireless as ever, I see.
Then, why don't we continue over there?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's starting to get dark. Let's call practice here for today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no! Tono, Mita, I'm so sorry...!
I didn't mean to make you practice with me for so long...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Don't mind us. I'm happy to help whenever, so don't hesitate to ask!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You still have a couple of rough patches to work through, but I think you'll be fine in time for our event as long as you keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay! Thank you very much.
I promise to be ready by then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I really want to help Kohane somehow since she's been working her butt off every day...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, An, about our meeting tomorrow...
An emergency came up, so I won't be able to make it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
An emergency...?
Then, I guess I'll just have to go it alone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, are you free tomorrow?
You too, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't have any animal caretaker committee duties to do tomorrow, so I was planning on going home early to practice somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have library committee business to take care of tomorrow... But I may be able to leave early if I tell them what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm free too. I don't have work tomorrow, so my plan was to go train somewhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's all go to Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? To Crawl Green...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Kohane, Toya, neither of you have been there yet, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It'll be an opportunity to actually see what it's like, and it should be a nice breath of fresh air for Kohane. Two birds with one stone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been wanting to see what it's like. I can't wait to find out...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
I've been curious as to what the place where Ken and his team debuted is like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good. I also kinda want to go since that message has been bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No problem!
Then, we'll meet at my place after school and head over to Crawl Green together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
The next day after school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm...
Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohaneee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...? Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! You were sleeping so soundly that I felt bad waking you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Thanks for doing it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had trouble falling asleep after practice yesterday. I managed to get through classes today, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. You ran out of gas just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Wait... Oh no! What time is it now...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness. I still have time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promised to meet with An and the others after school today. Thank you for waking me, Minori. I should be able to make it in time now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I still have some time until we're supposed to meet. What should I do until then...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to fall asleep again like I just did, so maybe I should head over to Weekend Garage now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Then, I should let the others know that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?
An sent me a message. I wonder why...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there she is! Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
I was so surprised when you said you were waiting by the gate!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry.
Toya said that he still has some library committee stuff to take care of. Akito's gonna wait for him, and we're gonna meet at Crawl Green.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay... But we have a lot of time on our hands. We're not supposed to meet until 6:30...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, about that...
I was hoping to hang out with you for a bit before we headed over to Crawl Green.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hang out? With me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, because you've been practicing nonstop lately.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I've been trying to come up with ways to help you somehow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is how I landed on trying to give you a little break. We can hang out, talk, laugh and have fun together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was hoping that Akito and Toya would also be here, but I guess it was short notice then... So it'll be just us today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you have bags under your eyes...! You didn't stay out super late again, did you?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? No, I've stopped doing that!
I don't want my dad to worry, so I'm avoiding staying out late now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I have been staying up late trying to get a clearer picture in my head of what I want to do like Taiga said...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... S-Sorry, An!
I can't help but want to practice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you... But I totally understand how you feel. I sometimes get these sudden urges to practice too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like when I'm listening to Dad's CDs...
That feeling just starts welling up inside of me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so like you, An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, where do you want to go today...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I've already come up with a plan!
There's somewhere I really wanna check out today!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, didn't this clothing store just open up recently?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! They seem to have cute stuff that you'd probably look really good in, so let's check it out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, you've gotta try that on with this one-shoulder dress! I bet you're gonna look amazing in it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
A-An... The thing is... I found something that I think would look really good on you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! You found something for me?! That's so sweet of you! Lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It was over... Oh, here it is!
It's this jacket...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, it's adorable! And super fluffy!
Oh, there's even one in a different color that might look really good on you! We could try wearing matching outfits with them sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, we walked a ton.
Let's sit for a bit longer and head to our next...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Mhm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...?
Oh, she fell asleep...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I kinda don't want to wake her since she stayed up so late last night. I'll let her rest a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mhm... An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, she's leaning on me...
There, there. You're such an amazingly hard worker, Kohane... Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is the real Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm for it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I think it's worth a shot since you might strike it rich again like you did during STAY GOLDEN.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just how high is Kohane's ceiling...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time she sings, she makes my heart race and it's the greatest feeling in the world... And I'm sure she's gonna knock everyone's socks off during our next event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I wanna hear her sing more.
And I...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I... No, us... Akito, Toya...
We're going to put on the best event ever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane, you don't need to worry about anything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry for falling asleep on you like that, An... I had a lot of fun today. I really did. So thanks for inviting me out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, thanks for joining me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually wanted to hang out with you a little more, but we need to head over to Crawl Green soon...

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: Hey, An! Welcome back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Hey, it's you!
I didn't know opened up another shop here.

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: Things didn't exactly work out when I tried to do business on Main Street... Anyway, that girl next to you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: Hey, you're An's partner! Kohane, right? Alright, as a special treat, you can both have something on the house.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: Yeah, totally. I mean, An always gives me the best service whenever I go over to Ken's place, so I owe them this much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! In that case...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What do you want, Kohane?
I'm gonna get one with bananas and chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll get...

rows.Speaker: Ramen Chef
rows.Line:
Hey, An! How's it going?
You coming back from school?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was just...
Wait, what about your shop? Are you taking a break right now?

rows.Speaker: Ramen Chef
rows.Line: I'm sold out for the afternoon! More importantly, I heard from the owner of Crawl Green that you and your friends are putting on an event! Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: What?! He's actually giving you guys a shot?! That's incredible! Our little An's finally getting her chance to perform there...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: I still remember when Ken and his team performed there. I wanted to sing there way back when, but I never got a chance to...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Speaking of which, An, you're about the same age as when Ken and his team performed there all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard that too!
Which means we need to do better than they did back then...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Hahaha! I like your spirit!
I promise to go see you guys perform!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Ramen Chef
rows.Line: Also, are you singing today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Today? No, we just stopped by to hang out. Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right.

rows.Speaker: Ramen Chef
rows.Line:
Oh, that's too bad.
I was sort of hoping to hear you sing since it's been a little bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's sweet of you, but we have to be somewhere pretty...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we still have some time, so I think we can sing for a little bit. I kind of want to hear you sing too, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! You too, Kohane?
Alright, I guess I don't have much of a choice now...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
An's gonna sing for us?!
Then, I'm gonna listen too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Just one song, okay?
Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An really is such a cool person...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew...
Okay, that's all I have time for today!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh...? Where did all these people come from...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's incredible... They must've all gathered while An was singing just now...)

rows.Speaker: Ramen Chef
rows.Line: I remember when you were still so little. You've really come a long way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Of course I have. Honestly, how long ago are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Why did what they said just now sound so familiar...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Don't forget that I've been watching you since you were just a kid. It's only natural for me to want to see you become a fully-fledged artist.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: So, Taiga, good luck over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Right...
That old lady said something similar about Taiga.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An and Taiga were both born and raised in this city...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone here watched over them and showered them with warmth as they grew up.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The idea of all these nice people rooting for you as you try to make your dreams come true... It's so heartwarming.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And if I...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It'd be really nice if I were to also make those kinds of connections.)

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone, settle down!
An, here's your crepe with bananas and chocolate!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! So much whipped cream! Your crepes always look amazing!

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: And here's yours Kohane! Strawberries with whipped cream! Good luck with your event!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much! We promise to do our best!
Outside Crawl Green

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Akito! Toya!
Sorry about that! Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's okay. We actually just got here a second ago. We thought you'd already be here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
I guess the library committee kept you busy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, there was quite a bit to do, but I managed to leave when things settled down a bit. After that, Akito and I...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we decided to sing down by Main Street for a bit. I didn't feel like just hanging out around town...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...? Does that mean you're nervous about meeting the owner? Is it because of what he said about you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right...
Shinonome has some history with this place...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Enough with that already.
Let's head in and talk business.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Okay.
Crawl Green

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, we're here!
Anyone around?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(So this is Crawl Green...
It looks a little bigger than COL...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is where the legend began...
That stage is where those three sang together for the very first time.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So that's where Ken stood and sang when he was still in high school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The ceiling's very high...
We may need to sing louder than usual here if we're going to reach everybody in the back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's almost hard to believe that Ken and his team got the crowd going the way they did, considering it was their first show together...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing's changed since the last time I was here. Well, I guess the interior wouldn't change that quickly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm glad everything is the same. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to redeem myself for what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Why am I not able to sing like them?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I dragged the name of a legendary venue through the mud...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I won't make the same mistake again. I'll really get the crowd going this time.
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Is this everyone?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I heard that Arata wouldn't be able to make it today, but I didn't realize that you'd all be coming.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Including a familiar face. You didn't run away, then?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Anyway, as much as I want to shoot the breeze with all of you, we don't have time... Let's start with a soundcheck.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're done!
Thank you so much for going through all of that with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, I'm surprised by how you are helping us with the sound setup instead of asking one of your staff to handle everything.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Of course I'm handling it. I'm not young anymore but, as much as I want to ask one of the others to do this for me, I have a bit of an obsessive personality...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Especially when it comes to events involving performers with some momentum behind them. I want things to be done right, with no cut corners.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so like you.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Anyway, more importantly... I've been meaning to see you all in person at least once beforehand, so I'm glad you're all here today.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You in particular, Shinonome. I haven't seen you since that event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes...
I apologize for making a mess of things back then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But... Thank you for giving me the chance to sing that time. I appreciate you not cutting me off and letting me finish.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, what happened that day helped strengthen my resolve. So, I... I vow to not let the crowd down like that again.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll be expecting to see some good results from you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, I think he's learned his lesson.
Also, you're starting to scare the others.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Ah, excuse me...
Anyway, you must be Aoyagi, and you must be An's partner...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes. My name is Kohane Azusawa!
It's nice to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yes, likewise. You put on a good performance during your last event. An definitely has an eye for spotting talent.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, um... Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, Kohane's seriously the best!
Uncle Taiga even likes her so much that he's been teaching her how to sing better!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
What...?
You're the one Taiga's taken under his wing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...? Y-Yes, that's me...!
He's already taught me so much...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I see... The old him would've never done anything like this. The only people he ever gave singing advice to were Nagi and Ken.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The old him...?
So, you've known him for quite a long time.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yes, I'd say since around the time he started singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-That long...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I mean, everyone my age has known him for about that long. Once Taiga and Nagi began making a name for themselves, everyone's eyes were on them.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green

rows.Line:
(This is so strange...
All that pressure I was feeling a second ago is all gone now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hey, she's pretty good!
The owner of this place really does have an eye for talent!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wow! She seems like a totally different person!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I can see everyone's faces so clearly...
They're all smiling and having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You're doing great, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I think I can sing a little harder.
That might give them a better sense of what I'm feeling...!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Not bad. That sort of high you feel when you sing on stage. I can feel it through her song.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. So this is what she's seeing and feeling.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I may not be the best teacher, but she's definitely figured out what I was trying to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She's singing while looking at each person's face.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: People can convey their feelings to one another by making eye contact. And the same is true for the way someone sings.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I was confident she was capable of this much.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nice singing! Keep it up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, Taiga just praised me...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so happy. That means my song's reaching him...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (His booming voice is exciting the rest of the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all waving their hands around. I can't tell if this is my voice or if it's someone else's...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I want to keep responding to them!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because I can still...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You can keep going, right?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Yes. Yes, I can...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can reach that place again...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can go back to where Miku and Luka led me that time...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(You've gotta be kidding me...
Wh-What am I seeing right now...?!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I-It's like...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The way she's singing... It's almost as if she's...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No way...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's like Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How the...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I-Is it just me or does she look like Nagi...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I-Incredible...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What in the world just happened...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The way she's singing...
I feel unbelievably moved for some reason...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (My body... It feels electric... How's she doing this...?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She really is the best...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She still hasn't reached her ceiling...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, hang on...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is this why Taiga had me walk around the city...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All the people he and An helped me meet and make personal connections with... As well as Taiga himself and An's dad...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all want to hear me sing, and I want them to hear me sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This feeling. I can see how important it is when it comes to singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you all for listening.
The show's just getting started, so I hope you stay and enjoy yourselves until the end!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Next, we have EVER!
Crawl Green

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
(Wow, Azusawa's beyond legit...
Now I feel embarrassed about saying that she might repeat what she did during STAY GOLDEN.)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
(Still, what an atmosphere...!
We can't let what she created go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
We're not letting her hog all the glory!
Let's hear it, you guys! Show us what you got!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That was an insane performance.
You should rest until it's our turn, so try to get your voice back by then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Okay...! Thanks, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: The way you sang gave the rest of us so much energy! It's totally fine if you lie down, so try to recover some strength before it's you guys' turn!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...!
I kind of want to watch everyone from backstage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! That was awesome...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here, take this! You need to stay hydrated!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, thanks. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Next is...this guy!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(...?!
Whoa, this place...! It's totally on fire!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Azusawa created this absolutely electric atmosphere for us, and EVER sent everyone flying sky high.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(Now it's my turn, and...
I'm gonna do things my way!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I know you guys can do better than that! Let's have some fun! It's time to get in the groove and dance to the rhythm!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
When did Kotaro get this good?!
I really love the way he sings! It's so easy to dance to!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (I'm projecting my voice way better than usual! The crowd's totally into it and I'm nailing every word of the lyrics! This is amazing!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Tono! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Haha. What a show. I've never experienced this kind of atmosphere before. It's so hot that just breathing is making my throat dry out.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Still, I can't get what Kohane did out of my mind. I've been desperately wanting to sing after witnessing that...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I may be at my limit already...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
You can all still keep going, right?
Let's keep this energy up!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa! Tono's gotten better too!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, has he always been this aggressive? His presence is almost overwhelming...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, we're up soon. How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm all warmed up and ready to sing whenever!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're ready too, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah. Thanks, Akito...
I'm all set to go, so you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, don't forget what we promised. We're gonna totally blow the roof off this place, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you remembered...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Next is our headliners...!
Take it away, Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go...!
We're gonna make it so everyone here goes home saying this was the best event ever! Including the owner!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Give it everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito! You gotta do better than that time you were here with Shepard!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know I will!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This atmosphere... It's almost unprecedented... I couldn't tell at all from backstage.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This pressure... What an incredible feeling...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've never felt this much energy before...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Man! All I wanna do right now is sing my lungs out!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I don't understand...
It's like I can see the faces of everyone in the audience even better now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all sweaty and exhausted... But I also get the sense that they want us to sing and energize this place even more!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here we go! Try to keep up, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm okay. Because there's only one thing that I need to do here...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Don't think about anything else besides singing...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's so nice to have An here next to me. I feel like we can reach all the people I couldn't when I was by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Right now... We can do anything...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's so good right now... Scary good...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(But for some reason...
Singing together like this... I feel like we can do anything.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The way Azusawa's singing...
It's like she's trying to push us forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Are we all managing to hang on?
I'm not sure, but this energy... It's so compelling, yet comfortable.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've always wondered how far Kohane could go, but I didn't realize she could be this good a singer...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And the way she's singing... She's trying to push us higher.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means there's only one thing we need to do. We need to use this energy to fly even higher!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Shinonome's jumped out in front...
The way he's singing... It has such a powerful allure...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I've never seen such an excited audience. More excited than when I sang by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought I'd used up all of my energy, but I'm still going. And I'm feeling hotter and hotter.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to go as high as I can!
And I want to keep going even higher!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This event's totally off the hook...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone has been so good!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
(This event...
It might actually be able to match RADder's...!)

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
(Also, that kid...
He's come a long way to be able to put on something like this.)

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
When RADder debuted...
When RAD WEEKEND happened...and became the stuff of legends...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I've become convinced that I'll never get to see an event like that again.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Actually, you may be in for a bit of a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I think you were right, Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (We're seeing their true capabilities here.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (A part of me has been wondering this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anyone's going to surpass what happened that night, I'd have to say...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I met that girl for the first time after she performed at STAY GOLDEN. I saw a tiny part of Nagi in her, but it was fragmented and incomplete...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(Which caught my attention.
This all began with me being curious.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the next generation of singers is going to help keep our dream alive...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The next generation, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(Hah...
I guess a part of me felt the same way as Nagi...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Not all of me...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (That night... I decided to take our music and carry it even further...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Taiga...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess it's my own fault for half-heartedly getting mixed up in other people's business.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm going, Ken.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You know this all too well...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't like getting involved while not being able to fully commit myself. And there's one last thing that I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I'm going to get that out of the way and return to what I was doing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wow, I'm parched...!
I don't think I can even walk!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm exhausted too...
Actually, I think we're all totally spent.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, we'll need to keep working on our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree... Still, I believe we put on our best performance to date during this event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we definitely have Azusawa to thank for that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She seems the most exhausted out of all of us. But I guess she should be since she sang the most.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did so awesome, Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh. Hehe. An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I did it...
And it's because you guys all said that you believed in me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, An, you telling me that you wanted to hear me at my best especially helped...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was pretty afraid of singing all by myself, but I'm so glad that I did... Thanks for believing in me, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh...
No, I'm just really tired!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna go outside to get some fresh air...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay... See you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
How awesome was that event?!
And that girl in the beginning! She was so good!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah, but so was everyone else!
And the atmosphere they created... They're really trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: At this rate, they might actually succeed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hey, did you guys just...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It sounds like we may actually succeed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we've definitely made some progress, but we can't let up here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But that's really nice to hear...
I hope we can keep up this momentum.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, also...
I hope Taiga and An's dad enjoyed the show.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't say if we were able to surpass the first event Taiga and his team put on...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But for now, as long as everyone enjoyed our event...)
Several dozen minutes later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I only have a few days left before I leave.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Before that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That girl needs to know. What was “most important” to us was nothing so cute.
